_desc: Cost-multiplier robustness for the full-universe headline (paper Section 10). The per-fill friction (time-of-day half-spread plus commission, charged round-trip in both arms) is scaled by the multiplier and the all-strategy rank-IC gap (Arm C minus Arm N) is recomputed with the effective-N block bootstrap (~20 correlation blocks, 5000 replications, seed 12345). Aggregated statistics only, no raw prints.
source: tape-side stage (licensed data); aggregate gap statistics only
endpoint: all-strategy rank-IC gap (Arm C clean-tuned minus Arm N naive-tuned, both scored on executable out-of-sample)
reading: The fidelity gap is near-invariant to the cost level, dipping slightly from 1x and staying positive and significant through 5x. Because the naive and clean arms trade at parity, a cost multiplier debits both arms near-identically, moving the level of each arm's rank-IC but not the fidelity difference between them.
